question: Which sport is Leander Paes associated with?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Tennis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Leander Paes** is a renowned Indian **tennis player**.
 
• He has won numerous **Grand Slam titles** in men's doubles and mixed doubles.
 
• Paes is known for his exceptional **performance in doubles tennis**.
 
• He has represented India in the **Olympics** and has won a **bronze medal in singles** at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics.
 
• Leander Paes has also been a part of the Indian **Davis Cup team** for many years, contributing significantly to the team's success.
 
• He has been awarded the **Padma Shri** and the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna**, which are among India's highest sporting honors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Table Tennis**__

 __
 
• **Table Tennis** is a sport in which two or four players hit a lightweight ball back and forth using small rackets.
 
• It is also known as **ping pong**.
 
• The sport originated in **England** during the 19th century.
 
 
 
• **Badminton**__
 __
 
• **Badminton** is a racquet sport played using racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net.
 
• The game can be played in **singles (one player per side)** or **doubles (two players per side)**.
 
• It is most commonly played as a recreational outdoor activity in a yard or on a beach.
 
 
 
• **Squash**__
 
 
• **Squash** is a racquet sport played by two (singles) or four players (doubles) in a four-walled court with a small, hollow rubber ball.
 
• It is recognized by the **International Olympic Committee** but is not an Olympic sport.
 
• The sport has its origins in **England** in the early 19th century.
